information:
**Source Links**

- ONS indicator page (provides download links):  
  `https://www.ons.gov.uk/explore-local-statistics/indicators/domestic-gas-consumption`  
  Download link for the full dataset (XLSX):  
  `https://www.ons.gov.uk/explore-local-statistics/api/v1/data.xlsx?indicator=domestic-gas-consumption&time=all`

- Original source data (Department for Energy Security and Net Zero):  
  `https://www.gov.uk/government/collections/sub-national-gas-consumption-data`

**Domestic gas consumption (kWh) median values (per meter point) for the five unitary authorities**

| Authority | 2012 (kWh) | 2023 (kWh) | Drop (kWh) |
|-----------|------------|------------|------------|
| Flintshire | 12,571.0 | 9,289.3 | 3,281.7 |
| County Durham | 13,681.0 | 10,636.2 | 3,044.8 |
| Bedford | 12,713.0 | 9,960.1 | 2,752.9 |
| North Lincolnshire | 13,031.0 | 10,054.2 | 2,976.8 |
| Telford & Wrekin | 11,879.0 | 9,101.0 | 2,778.0 |

**Result**

Flintshire experienced the biggest decline in domestic gas consumption between 2012 and 2023, with a drop of 3,281.7 kWh.
